Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Goal: Evaluate Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) for PHI-handling inference workloads (clinical NLP pipelines).
- Key constraints: data residency in US, customer-managed KMS, and strict egress controls.
- Expected traffic: steady-state ~50 req/s with burst to 200 req/s; model choices likely 7B-13B quantized variants.

Next step: schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive focused on Private/VPC architecture (networking, auth/KMS, deployment topology, monitoring/SLAs). Recommended attendees: your infra lead + network security, and on our side: Dev (SE), Hannah (AE), and myself.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed Feb 11, 10:00–11:00 AM PST
- Thu Feb 12, 9:00–10:00 AM PST
- Mon Feb 16, 11:00–12:00 PM PST

Please let me know which works and who from your side should join. Also if possible, send over a short network contact (name/email) we can loop in for the firewall/discovery items.

I attached a short Private overview we typically share ahead of architecture calls.

Thanks —

A few quick notes before the call so we can prep:
- We'll need to validate egress requirements and IP allowlisting with our security team.

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks — Dev here (Solutions Engineer) and I'll lead the technical deep dive. Confirming Thu Feb 12, 9:00 AM PST for a 60-minute session. I'll send a calendar invite after we lock attendees.

Pre-call asks so we can make the session productive (short checklist):
- Preferred deployment: VPC-hosted (cloud) vs on-prem rack (co-lo). If on-prem, any constraints on physical networking (public IPs, NAT, proxies).
- VPC subnet CIDR ranges we can use for host-to-host setup (if cloud VPC).
- Allowlist: do you require specific outbound IP ranges? Any existing firewall appliance in path?
- Auth: Okta SAML + SCIM OK? Are you using client certs or mutual TLS internally for services?
- KMS: confirm AWS KMS CMKs or HSM details we should evaluate (ARNs OK to share pre-call).

Proposed technical agenda (60 min):
1) Introductions & high-level goals (5 min)
2) Redwood Private architecture walkthrough (25 min)
3) Network/auth/KMS deep-dive with your infra team (20 min)
4) Next steps and rollout options (10 min)

I'll include a short runbook we use for firewall/outbound rules in the invite.

—Dev

Thanks Dev — Thu Feb 12 at 9:00 AM PST works for our team. Attaching a short network contact sheet. A few answers up front:

- Deployment: leaning toward a VPC-hosted Private with peering to our on-prem via AWS Direct Connect. We can discuss the on-prem option if latency requires it.
- Outbound allowlisting: we generally prefer to limit outbound to specific IPs. Can you share the list of expected egress IP ranges?
- Firewall ports: what ports/protocols will you need for control plane, data plane, and metrics?
- KMS: we use AWS KMS CMKs — we can share ARNs under NDA.

Sandeep will join for the network portion. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
